reports.rendered_content: Projected panorama fallback shader implements a two-projector blend system using continuous visibility/quality scores without hard thresholds. Primary sample is always computed from projectedPanoMap; secondary sample from projectedSecondaryPanoMap only when projectedUseSecondary==1 and a valid position offset exists. Blend mode 0 uses primary only, mode 1 uses secondary only, mode 2 adds primary dominance factor 1.15, mode 3 adds secondary dominance 1.15. Winner-takes-most weighting applies power-4 exponent to primaryScore and secondaryScore, with coverage diagnostic available when projectedDebugCoverage==1 (four-state: red/cyan/magenta/white).
